concepts.evidence_span: The phases are slow start and congestion avoidance.
In the slow phase, the cwnd starts getting bigger in size, first slowly, then rapidly, until the ssthresh is reached.
Once reached, the congestion control phase begins, where the cwnd slowly grows in size until a congestion occurs (timeout).
